AcceptChannelHandshake.name: AcceptChannelHandshake
AcceptChannelHandshake.documentation: Accepts a pending channel handshake request from another AWS account.

CancelChannelContract.name: CancelChannelContract
CancelChannelContract.documentation: Cancels a pending channel contract created within the last 30 days. A request for a channel contract that isn't PENDING, including one that is already CANCELED, fails with a ValidationException.

CreateChannelContract.name: CreateChannelContract
CreateChannelContract.documentation: Creates a new channel contract and sends it to the signatory for signature. In the Sandbox catalog, the channel contract is accepted automatically.

CreateChannelHandshake.name: CreateChannelHandshake
CreateChannelHandshake.documentation: Creates a new channel handshake request to establish a partnership with another AWS account.

CreateProgramManagementAccount.name: CreateProgramManagementAccount
CreateProgramManagementAccount.documentation: Creates a new program management account for managing partner relationships.

CreateRelationship.name: CreateRelationship
CreateRelationship.documentation: Creates a new partner relationship between accounts.

GetChannelContract.name: GetChannelContract
GetChannelContract.documentation: Retrieves details of a specific channel contract.

GetRelationship.name: GetRelationship
GetRelationship.documentation: Retrieves details of a specific partner relationship.

ListChannelContracts.name: ListChannelContracts
ListChannelContracts.documentation: Lists channel contracts based on specified criteria.

ListChannelHandshakes.name: ListChannelHandshakes
ListChannelHandshakes.documentation: Lists channel handshakes based on specified criteria.

ListProgramManagementAccounts.name: ListProgramManagementAccounts
ListProgramManagementAccounts.documentation: Lists program management accounts based on specified criteria.

ListRelationships.name: ListRelationships
ListRelationships.documentation: Lists partner relationships based on specified criteria.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.documentation: Lists tags associated with a specific resource.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.documentation: Adds or updates tags for a specified resource.

UpdateProgramManagementAccount.name: UpdateProgramManagementAccount
UpdateProgramManagementAccount.documentation: Updates the properties of a program management account.

UpdateRelationship.name: UpdateRelationship
UpdateRelationship.documentation: Updates the properties of a partner relationship.
